title: Plexus scores data-flow gold
description:
As an operator, I want plexus evaluate accuracy to score data-flow gold, so that arrows have a real scorecard.

Feature: Plexus data-flow accuracy

  Scenario: Flow endpoints and type
    Given gold for a data flow from the app to Checkr of type api_call
    And the scanner emits that flow
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for the data-flow layer
    Then the case is a hit

  Scenario: Missing flow
    Given gold for a database_query from the app to the user store
    And the scanner emits no such flow
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for the data-flow layer
    Then the case is a miss
